notes: New mod: Slayers Club. It shows on Dauntless Forever's Mods page next to Lantern Client. Switch it on and Lantern Client puts the Slayers Club in your save (shows after your next login); switch it off and it is taken out when the game is closed. Needs Lantern Client running and its own mod (DFTrainer) on. Only the club is changed; your save is backed up first.
